concours.name: La tente du Concours
concours.alt: The contest tent at eye level, painted in ink and gouache: blue-and-red striped canvas walls, bunting and little lights, a plank floor. On a three-tier wooden stage a prize-giving is under way: two identical framed pictures of the same grumpy cat hang on the back canvas, a bumblebee with a rosette loops the loop overhead, a crow croaks on top of a tower of melons, a girl lifts an enormous green pear, a grinning pumpkin blushes beside a gold trophy, a goose wears a huge purple rosette, and a judge in a wig pins a blue rosette on a giant cabbage. Small animal spectators watch from the front. On the left wall the tent entrance is laced shut, then a doorway with yellow-and-red striped curtains and a plank door with a jam jar. On the right a carrot door and a pink-cake door, and a ladder up to a balcony with blue, yellow, red and green doors.

buvette.name: La buvette · Refreshment Tent
buvette.alt: The refreshment tent of the vegetable show, painted in ink and gouache under yellow-and-red striped canvas with bunting and little lights. On the left a doorway with blue-and-red striped curtains leads back to the contest tent, beside crates and a checked-cloth table. At a long tasting table a judge recoils from a cake sunk into a crater, a judge gasps at a wobbly green cake held up by a little goblin, a grandma gives a thumbs-up beside a perfect pink cake, and a judge holds up all ten fingers beside an ice-cream parfait with a cherry. In front a kindly grandpa pours lemonade for two nervous children holding their vegetables, a row of mice on a bench watches a black-and-white monster movie on a little screen, and twin drummers in matching red uniforms march by. A barrel and hay bales stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Back through the blue-and-red curtains to the contest tent

confitures.name: Les confitures
confitures.alt: The jam tent, painted in ink and gouache in cool morning light: blue-and-red striped canvas and straw, seen from high up along one very long tasting table. A peacock sits in a toy van admiring his portrait, a tiny ant hauls a medal up a jar, a serious owl peers down from a jam jar, a pony shakes its head at a rabbit holding up a ticket, a two-tier jam cake stands on its plate, a hedgehog studies a diamond through a magnifying glass beside a carrot, a mouse drips under a teal umbrella full of holes, a toy pier sinks into a washtub, a small tomato sits shyly by a giant one, a cat naps in her own little roped corner with her rosette, a badger peers at a stingray in a glass tank, a girl holds up a teal pocket knife, a mouse drops a wilted lettuce into a crate, a puppy sits innocently beside a chewed slipper, and two pigs shake on a deal over a fine marrow. A jam pan steams on a stove by the plank door on the left, a wasp circles a jar and a pig licks spilt jam on the straw.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the plank door by the jam-jar picture to the main tent

potager.name: Le potager
potager.alt: The vegetable show, painted in ink and gouache in warm late-afternoon light, seen at eye level through the blue-and-red striped tent canvas, with the back rolled up onto real vegetable beds and bunting. A tall wooden show stand rises in the middle: an owl on top gives a thumbs-up, a gold trophy stands beside the tiniest pumpkin, two mice share one red apple, a cake carries one sunflower seed, and a beaver judge sorts entry tags in a whirl. An old dean in cap and gown holds a rosette with dignity, three judges peer at a giant marrow through magnifying glasses, a smiling knight rides a gnu past waving onlookers, a carrot grown into the shape of a rabbit sits beside a real rabbit with its nose in the air, and a grandma pins a rosette on a boy carrying pies. On the left is the plank door with a painted carrot; on the right a prize table of cakes with rosettes, and behind it a little side tent where villagers crowd round a cake table.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the door with the carrot to the main tent

zooms.label: la petite tente
zooms.hint: Look into the little tent on the right

gateaux.name: Les gâteaux
gateaux.alt: The cake tent at dusk, painted in ink and gouache: cool blue evening light through the blue-and-red striped canvas and a glowing lantern by the plank door, looking straight down a long judging table to the open far end. A girl on a stepladder waters a sunflower that has grown up through the roof, and a giraffe pokes its head in through another hole. At the far end a seagull sings opera while two judges cheer; an elephant gazes at a party cake bristling with candles; a grumpy pony judge frowns at a row of cupcakes; a judge peers through a huge magnifying glass; a goat runs off with a purple rosette while its judge clutches his cheeks; a judge winces at his green soup as a little dog backs away; a boy behind a toppling stack of cake pans holds up five fingers; and a little table bows under one enormous pumpkin. A tall blue dresser of cakes under glass domes stands on the right.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the plank door to the main tent

zooms.label: le buffet des gâteaux
zooms.hint: Look closer at the blue cake dresser

jury.name: La loge du jury
jury.alt: The jury booth inside the show tent at eye level, painted in ink and gouache: a round room of red-and-blue striped canvas, closed overhead, with a round blue rug on a plank floor. In the middle a giant plain green marrow statue on a plinth blocks two bewigged judges pressed up against it. A judge dozes, smiling, in a red armchair with a sun hat on his lap, under a little framed picture of a sunny beach. Another judge spoons into a crème brûlée at a small round table, and a hedgehog judge in a white wig shrugs at a lumpy green dish on a stool. In front, a duck settles into a tin washtub, and a snail follows a wooden signpost. A blue door on the left leads back to the main tent; a dark-red door on the right leads to the rejects room.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the blue door to the main tent

doors.label: Les refus du jury
doors.hint: Through the dark-red door to the rejects room

refus.name: Les refus du jury · Rejects
refus.alt: The rejects room behind the jury booth, painted in ink and gouache under grey-and-white striped canvas in cool light. On the left a dark-red wooden door with an iron latch leads back to the jury booth. Behind a grey-clothed table a frowning judge holds up a fuzzy green moldy pie as two flies circle it, next to a cake made of mud that only a delighted piglet admires. In front, a small blue whale in a wooden tub stares sadly at a tiny slice of cake on a stool. On the right a mockingbird perches on a tailor's dummy whose prize waistcoat hangs its buttons on thin threads, beside a tiny judge with hands on hips. A coat rack hangs on the canvas wall.

doors.label: La loge du jury
doors.hint: Back through the dark-red door to the jury booth

rates.name: Les ratés
rates.alt: The disaster corner of the show tent on a rainy afternoon, painted in ink and gouache: cool gray-green light, red-and-blue striped canvas, a wet plank floor and rain dripping through a hole in the roof into a bucket. An open yellow plank door on the left shows the main tent's striped canvas and a white-clothed table beyond, and on the right a tent flap tied with blue ribbons opens into the special-prizes tent, where a big pumpkin waits on a green-clothed table. Behind a long white-clothed judging table everything fails at once: a tiered cake slides sideways as its little chef topper dives for safety, a soufflé slumps in its dish before a dismayed judge, a pot of green soup steams with stink under a fly, and a judge's sneeze blows the fluff off a prize dandelion. In front, a can of baked beans bursts over a bearded judge, and a lady in a flowered hat sits on a crate shaking a pebble out of her fancy shoe.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the yellow door to the main tent

doors.label: Les prix spéciaux
doors.hint: Through the tent flap tied with blue ribbons to the special prizes

prix.name: Les prix spéciaux · Special Prizes
prix.alt: The special-prizes corner of the show tent just after the rain, painted in ink and gouache: bright silvery light, red-and-white striped canvas walls all round, hung with blue rosettes and strings of little blue-and-red bunting. On the left a tent flap tied with blue ribbons opens back onto the rainy disaster corner. On a green-clothed platform an elderly judge on a step-ladder pins a rosette on a gigantic marrow, a champion pumpkin's little red cape flies off in the breeze, and a marrow carved into a little dragon wears its ribbon. On the floor a jack-in-the-box springs open in streamers as a kitten leaps back, a mouse points at a spot on a big ladybird, and a purple octopus in a washtub waves one arm high above its head.

doors.label: Les ratés
doors.hint: Back through the tent flap to the disaster corner

espoirs.name: Les espoirs
espoirs.alt: The children's corner of the show tent on a bright spring morning, painted in ink and gouache: red-and-white striped canvas closed all round with coloured paper bunting, a red plank door on the left back to the main tent and a green door with a gold star on the right. On a low green-clothed stage three children and a grandmother crowd round a little sweet table of cakes and lollipops, wishing to stay; a boy kneels to point at a tiny seedling sprouting in its clay pot on a stool; and a prawn clings to a big open storybook it can't put down. Below the stage a teddy bear snoozes under a patchwork quilt beside a mended rag doll and a toy boat, and three snails creep along their own lane, each carrying a little flag.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the red door to the main tent

doors.label: Les valeurs sûres
doors.hint: Through the green door with the gold star to the senior judges

valeurs.name: Les valeurs sûres · Safe Bets
valeurs.alt: The senior judges' room of the show tent, painted in ink and gouache in soft daylight through blue-and-white striped canvas hung with blue rosettes, closed all round, with a green door with a gold star on the left back to the children's corner and a stack of empty crates on the right. At a white-clothed judging bench a very old tortoise judge in round spectacles and a bow tie tastes jam from a jar, an old judge stares startled, a lady judge tastes a spoon of jam with her eyes closed and smiles, and beside her on the bench stands a lookalike carrot with a big nose and a bushy beard. On the floor in front a young green tortoise plods steadily past an open storybook, a mouse beside a wedge of cheese raises a paw to ask a question, and a tin robot works through a whole bucket of potatoes, peel flying.

doors.label: Les espoirs
doors.hint: Back through the green door with the gold star to the children's corner

sante.name: La santé
sante.alt: The first-aid tent at dawn, painted in ink and gouache: soft pink-gold light through the open flap, white-and-green striped canvas, a green plank door, a first-aid chest with a green cross, shelves of rolled bandages, piles of folded blankets and big pitchers. One little rain cloud rains only on a pot of prize roses. A horse shakes his head at a greasy burger held out to an old man resting on a camp bed, whose very worn shoe has a flapping sole and peeking toes. Through the flap a little green vegetable van is parked right by the doorway, and a happy dog trots back in, lead trailing. A goat leaps off past a wobbly chair, a judge coughs at the black smoke rising from a burnt pie, and a cautious hedgehog holds up a tiny umbrella under the clear sky. A proud lion sulks in a headband of bunny ears; a dog hides under a lily-patterned seat cushion with sausages peeking out; a quaint painted wooden yo-yo lies beside a pocket watch on a stool; and a small grass snake naps under a straw sun hat.

doors.label: La tente du Concours
doors.hint: Go back through the green door to the main tent

potager_casier.name: La petite tente
potager_casier.alt: A look into the vegetable show's little side tent, in the same warm late-afternoon light and blue-and-red striped canvas, with leeks and cabbages showing through the drapes and wicker baskets stacked on the right. A crowd presses round a small round table: a judge bites a pie and rings his brass bell at once, a sweating judge gulps a tall glass of water beside a dish of red chillies, an old lady hands a young woman in a straw hat a brown paper package and a small slip, a kind old judge pats the shoulder of a nervous little girl clutching her first jam jar, a tiered white cake carries two sugar swans, and a green parrot bows low to the giant prize marrow.

gateaux_casier.name: Le buffet des gâteaux
gateaux_casier.alt: A close-up of the blue cake dresser in the cake tent at dusk, in the same cool blue light and warm lantern glow between blue-and-red striped canvas. Cakes sit under glass domes on its shelves while the buffet is raided: two sweating judges fan themselves with giant fern leaves, a hen in a red bow tie pecks one crumb from the prize pie, a little girl in a party hat holds the limp string of her popped balloon, a mouse tiptoes up beside a wobbling tower of marmalade jars on a stool, a tabby cat creeps under the table toward a dropped blob of cream, and a toy delivery van has crashed under the table, its honey pots oozing all over the floor.
